name: fission-marketplace

metadata.description: Fission Labs' private catalogue of agentic skills. Right now: one bundle, fl-design-system, with a separate skill per UI component. Standards and delivery bundles are deferred to a later round — see README.

plugins.name: fl-design-system
plugins.description: Fission UI — one skill per component, each detecting and adapting to whatever design system a project already uses.

_comment_upstream: High-level/non-component skills (React & Next.js practices, accessibility, framework upgrades, library-version-matched guidance) are NOT built here — they're already published by their maintainers (Vercel, TanStack). See UPSTREAM.md for the install commands. This marketplace only carries what's unique to Fission's own component library, per the proposal's three-question rule.
